display_name: 比特币矿业/AI HPC 数据中心转型
sub_industry: Bitcoin mining, power-backed digital infrastructure, AI/HPC data center conversion
current_cycle_state: Post-halving mining economics remain highly sensitive to Bitcoin price, network difficulty, power cost and machine efficiency; equity-market pricing increasingly distinguishes pure mining capacity from credible contracted AI/HPC data-center conversion.

primary_anchor.method: EV/Sales or PS with normalized EBITDA bridge and BTC treasury adjustment
primary_anchor.reason: GAAP net income is frequently distorted by Bitcoin fair-value marks, impairment/revaluation, realized gains, depreciation and power-site expansion. Revenue and normalized EBITDA capacity are more informative, but must be adjusted for Bitcoin price, hashrate, power cost and fleet efficiency.

secondary_anchors.method: EV/EH or market cap per energized EH/s
secondary_anchors.reason: Useful for pure miners because hashrate is the core production capacity, but it ignores power cost, uptime, fleet efficiency, curtailment revenue and balance-sheet differences.
When a miner has signed, financeable AI/HPC colocation or GPU-cloud contracts, the contracted MW/ARR/EBITDA stream should be valued separately from Bitcoin mining.

secondary_anchors.method: Peer PS, EV/Sales and EV/hashrate comparison
secondary_anchors.reason: MARA, Riot, CleanSpark, Cipher, IREN and other listed miners provide the current market language for power-backed infrastructure and mining capacity.

weak_or_floor_anchors.reason: Book value captures cash, Bitcoin holdings, sites and miners, but hardware depreciates quickly and power-interconnection optionality is not fully reflected.

disabled_anchors.reason: GAAP EPS can swing from losses to large profits from Bitcoin fair-value accounting and does not represent stable recurring earnings.
Loss years, break-even crossings and fair-value accounting make profit CAGR unsuitable as a primary valuation input.

anchor_switch_rationale: If AI/HPC capacity is contracted with credible counterparties and financing, SOTP and contracted ARR/EBITDA receive higher weight. If AI conversion remains uncontracted, the anchor reverts to mining EV/Sales, EV/EH and BTC-cycle stress valuation.
valid_when: Bitcoin mining revenue remains the dominant disclosed revenue line
AI/HPC contracts are not yet large enough to dominate EBITDA
Current peer multiples can be observed from public listed miners
invalid_when: AI/HPC contracted revenue exceeds mining revenue or becomes the dominant EBITDA driver
Bitcoin price or network difficulty moves enough to reset mining margins
Major power-market, tax, or mining-regulation changes alter site economics
market_pricing_language: Pure miners are mainly priced on hashrate, BTC holdings, power cost and BTC beta. Miners with credible AI/HPC conversion receive a separate data-center optionality premium only when contracts, power availability and financing are visible.
key_cycle_indicators: Power cost per kWh and curtailment economics
Signed AI/HPC MW, ARR and EBITDA visibility
sources: Company SEC filings and investor relations releases
Public peer disclosures from listed Bitcoin miners
Market data services for current market cap and multiples
analyst_notes: For CleanSpark, explicitly run two cases: AI/HPC conversion succeeds versus remains mostly a pure Bitcoin miner.
